storyCards.headline: Everybody Have Fun Tonight: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Wang Chung's "Everybody Have Fun Tonight" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Everybody Have Fun Tonight was released in 1986.

"Everybody Have Fun Tonight" by Wang Chung.

Chart story — peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
